newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up sharply, export demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up sharply, export demand low.

text.p: Indian Castorseed June delivery prices on Wednesday rose sharply to 1,223/1,224 rupees per quintal from 1,200 rupees on hectic speculative buying, dealers said.
Lower than expected arrivals triggered increased buying by bull operators though fresh enquiries from exporters remained low.
"Earlier the market was oversold and short covering lifted prices upward but now at this rate the market looked overbought and poised for a correction," one operator said.
New crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained low at 30,000/32,000 bags (75 kg each) against daily average of 40,000/45,000 bags in the same period last year.
Groundnut oil slid by 1/2 rupees to 339/340 rupees per 10 kg amid sluggish physical buying and improved arrivals of 80/100 tonnes. Imported palm oil was steady at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by 4/5 rupees to 513/514 rupees per 15 kg.
